gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G21: ADOPTED 2026-08-27, BINDING ON THIS BATCH. GRADE THE MATCH, PRE-REGISTER THE NULL. On this instrument `find_matched` is a boolean over the whole tag-stripped body while the excerpt is centred on the FIRST occurrence, so A MATCH ESTABLISHES OCCURRENCE AND NEVER LOCATION. (a) A conclusion that depends ONLY on occurrence — a positive control, a digest pair, the G18 bracket — MAY be pre-registered on a match. (b) A conclusion that depends on WHERE the literal landed MAY NOT be pre-registered on a match; it is graded at read time under the 0819 rule. Any earlier occurrence, in navigation chrome or in the body, masks every later one, so a match-branch of this kind is one-sided by construction. (c) A null branch MAY be pre-registered, because added text cannot remove an occurrence and chrome therefore cannot produce a false null. A NULL IS CHROME-SAFE, NOT SAFE. (d) Where a presence-branch is graded at read time, the licence states in advance what this project's chrome holdings for that host do and do not cover, so the exposure is on the record before the result is.

gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G22: ADOPTED 2026-08-27. PAGE-STATE INEQUALITY DOES NOT LOCALISE CHANGE. A change in sha256 or bytes DOES NOT LOCALISE THE CHANGE AND IS NOT BY ITSELF EVIDENCE THAT ANY PARTICULAR SCOPED REGION CHANGED. Corollary: a digest series is not a change-detection series for a scoped region unless the window itself is compared. This is the converse of G20 and does not weaken it.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G23_case_insensitivity: Carried from 2026-08-27 close-out decision 3 and stated as a gate because it cuts BOTH ways. The search is case-insensitive: body.lower().find(find.lower()). A NULL therefore establishes that no case variant of the literal occurs in the reduced body — stronger than the record has been claiming. A MATCH correspondingly fires on ANY case variant ANYWHERE, and no row may read a match as carrying the literal's own casing.
